summary: Council consensus validated the documented agent-mcp MVP as a stageable v0.1.0 feature. Scope remains limited to the plan; reviewer safeguards are recorded as implementation and validation checks.
validation: 8 requirements, 5 Gherkin acceptance criteria, 5 tests, and 8 traceability rows validated
Three council perspectives recorded: planner_lite, reviewer, tech_lead_qa
Explicit non-goals preserve private MetaMCP authentication boundary and no Kubernetes/backwards compatibility
Stage dependencies preserve documented Stage 0 through Stage 8 ordering

issues.title: Path and command confinement must be reviewed for symlink races and arbitrary argv behavior
issues.details: Keep all path operations on the shared policy and verify boundary behavior before each operation; do not add a new command policy language.

issues.title: Stateful SSE and HTTP contexts must remain isolated
issues.details: Integration tests must cover interleaved requests and mismatched or missing working-directory headers.

issues.title: Main release publication must be serialized and rerun-safe
issues.details: Review and validate main-only concurrency, idempotent tag/release/image publication, and digest consistency.
